nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion

avis.texte: Sorry but this is not the same product with different packaging. This is a different formula that has successfully made my face and neck a mess of itchiness, redness and irritation. I had an old bottle to compare and have noticed several differences in the ingredient listing. First... you removed the skin rescue in the red bottle and I made the switch to the original ultra repair face moisturizer, now along with new packaging comes a new formula that I can't use. Thanks but no thanks... beginning the new search for a different product

avis.titre: I wanted to love it, but it burned my skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Well, I wanted to love this, but it hurt my skin. I used it three times, to make sure it wasnt just me needing to get used to it. All three times it kinda burned and my skin turned a little red. I am fair skinned, not moisturizer doesn't usually do this to me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First Aid Beauty Ultra repair face lotion daily hydration with colloidal oatmeal is very smooth and creamy! It applies like a dream. It absorbs very well while leaving you with a little glow. This lotion helps me in the winter when I feel like my skin is so dry from the forced heat and the winter winds! It's definitely worth a try. It's a tad pricey but in my opinion it's worth it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this moisturizer for a bit now, and it's one of those products that just feels easy to use everyday. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives good hydration without making my skin feel oily or heavy. I really like it for days when my skin feels dry or irritated because it feels calming and doesn't sting. The colloidal oatmeal definitely helps make it feel soothing, especially during colder weather or after using stronger skincare products. It also sits nicely under makeup, which surprised me because a lot of thicker moisturizers tend to pull in me. The only downside is that if you have very dry skin, you might want something richer at night. Overall, I think it's a solid everyday moisturizer, especially for sensitive skin or anyone who wants hydration without a heavy feel. Everything arrived clean, fresh, and well-packaged, and I was honestly impressed with how much product you get for the price.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love this. To start, the packaging is perfect. One pump can cover your house face and neck. I LOOVE that. The texture is perfection- feels lightweight to the touch but cushiony as it sets into the skin. Soothing, can use on my skin when it is in any shape. No fragrance. Perfection !!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this cream daily! It's super convenient, easy to apply, and lightweight. Leaves skin moisturized, fresh, and ready for whatever makeup routine you do. Would recommend!

I used it around the time when my skin was typically dry and it did not help one bit. My skin was way worse because of it. The whole 3 weeks that I used this i would wake up with very dry skin. As soon as I switched back to my regular moisturizer I noticed my skin getting better.
Mild and non—irritating and also very beneficial. This is a keeper

Noticed some skin changes the last few months (sensitivity), so had to stop using some of my regular products. I've used this moisturizer off and on for many years, and recently returned to it. Very light but hydrating, and makes it easy to layer with other products. I appreciate the hygienic pump bottle, but would love a low or no plastic option in the future.

avis.titre: definitely a staple in skincare routine!
avis.texte: Absolutely love the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Cream! It's super hydrating without feeling heavy or greasy, and it calms dry, sensitive skin almost instantly. I've noticed a big difference in how soft and smooth my skin feels, especially during colder days.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this cream daily! It's super convenient, easy to apply, and lightweight. Leaves skin moisturized, fresh, and ready for whatever makeup routine you do. Would recommend!

avis.titre: I have bought this product several times.
avis.texte: This product is the perfect texture, not too heavy and not too thin. A very little amount spreads over a large area and it does not irritate my face. I will continue to use this product.

I use this after washing my face with their face wash and it doesn't seem to hydrate my skin at all. My face is very dry and sensitive and my face feels dry after 10 min of applying this. I'm always trying different hydrating face creams but this one is not it. I wish I could return.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This literally feels sooo nice and refreshing on my skin! I did have a few breakouts but idk if it was from this products or my hormones. I don't really feel like there was much of a scent if any.
I needed a new moisturizer that might help with my rosacea. This came highly recommended and did not disappoint at all. I will keep buying this!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this brand- it is SO underrated these days! I use their cleanser as my second cleanse each night and it has been my "ride or die" for literal YEARS now. I love that this face lotion has NO residue or greasy feel to it! I'm not a fan of greasy skin. You could use multiple layers of this if you have very dry skin and apply makeup or skin tint right on top w no problems. I especially love to use it right after I dermaplane or have irritated my skin barrier w peels, etc. This product, no any product from this brand has ever broken me out- def. LOVE that!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Actually love this moisturizer. It has a thinner consistency which i love, it's not too heavy and just leaves your face feeling hydrated and soft. Absolutely would recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice face cream from FAB! I really like the texture and viscosity of this. avis.titre: Your skin will love this lotion

I have sensitive skin that sometimes turns red and irritated. This lotion helps. It sinks right in to leave my face feeling so soft. Make up goes on like a dream.

I received this free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this daily as soon as I got it. Has been a life saver for winter skin. Keeps my skin feeling soft and moisturized. Soaks in the skin and doesn't feel greasy.
love this cream but hate the packaging. its so much plastic for such a small amount. can we get bigger sizes please???

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product came just in time. The cold weather makes my skin so dry. I put this in my purse and whenever I feel like my skin gets dry I immediately apply and it helps so much. It's so smooth and light.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a really nice gel type moisturizer. Does not pill when I layer with SPF and makeup. I really like this moisturizer and would definitely buy more when the weather is hot!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First aid beauty is the best! The pump on this lotion is super convenient, the lotion itself is hydrating without being greasy and absolutely leaves my skin soft and smooth.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have loved using this product! It is almost like a gel moisturizer which I prefer! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The ultra repair face lotion by first aid beauty is amazing. It glides onto my skin so smoothly and feels very lightweight. My skin just soaks it up. A little goes a long way; one pump is enough for my face, neck, and chest. I would recommend trying this lotion.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion is such a goooood product! I love how moisturized & soft my face would feel after using it. I highly recommend using it day and night. Know that a little goes a long way!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm surprised at this little bottle! It's a small size, but packs a big punch. A little went a long way on my face. It left me feeling smooth and hydrated. Many brands leave me feeling greasy and just okay. This brand felt light, airy, and satisfied. I didn't smell anything which is fine by me, sometimes these products are too much for someone with frequent migraines.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time trying a First Aid Beauty product and I am absolutely blown away. This face lotion feels so moisturizing on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling hydrating. The colloidal oatmeal is a plus, my sensitive skin feels so calming on my skin. The bottle makes it easy to dispense the product without wasting it. I will be repurchasing this product once I finish it! Love love love!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ultra repair is a great name for this facial lotion. I have seb dermatitis and the addition of colloidal oatmeal is very soothing and non irritating to my already irritated skin. It brings moisture without feeling heavy or greasy.
It is light enough for under makeup and almost instantly soothes redness and irritation. I wish it was thicker but I can use multiple pumps.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the first aid beauty ultra repair face lotion, daily hydration with colloidal oatmeal in size 1.7oz. I applied this to my skin after cleansing, the consistency and texture seemed fine and I didn't have allergy concerns and made sure that I rubbed it all over your evenly and that there was no residue left over. Overall pretty good and would purchase again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It feels like a thicker lotion, but it goes on smooth and lightweight. Its a little heavier, so i need to be cautious in my oily areas. Quick drying. Marked it down as I feel like I went through it really fast for every day am/pm use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A few days after I started using the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Lotion Daily Hydration with Colloidal Oatmeal as my daily moisturizer, I said to a friend, "unfortunately, I am obsessed with this moisturizer and it's going to replace my holy grail moisturizer." My skin is slightly sensitive, slightly dry, and prone to some redness, and I think this may be the perfect moisturizer. It's hydrating without feeling too heavy, and I have noticed a reduction in the redness in my face since I began using it. I don't love products with a strong scent and this one is mild, barely there. I also think the packaging is cute and I always like face products that come in a pump. I will absolutely repurchase!

avis.titre: I wish I would've bought more when it was on sale!
avis.texte: I had been looking for a simple light moisturizer. I FOUND IT. I bought this when it was half off. I should've stocked up. It's the perfect every day, light but hydrating moisturizer. Will be purchasing time and time again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin is super dry, especially this time of the year. Not a super thick formula. No scent. It melts into the skin effortlessly and isn't sticky at all. I really like the consistency and will continue to use as my morning moisturizer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love this ultra repair face lotion. I have really dry skin and I'm always looking for products to help repair my skin and keep it hydrated. This face lotion did a wonderful job. It left my skin feeling so soft and hydrated and I'm really excited to start using this especially with winter being here. avis.titre: Weird scent but unscented overall, great moisturizer

Doesn't leave the skin glowy but slightly dewy.

avis.titre: Works so nice on dry faces

The cream's consistency is not as thick as others, has a minimal scent. It applies so smoothly and soaks into my skin without leaving me greasy at all. I have several extreme dry patches-around my nose folds and lips-from extreme weather. The first aid beauty repair lotion helped fix these dry spots within a week of continuous use. Much better results than the other lotions I've used. I am extremely happy with this product.

avis.titre: Perfect for winter skin and sensitive skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using First Aid Beauty Ultra Face Lotion for a couple weeks now and overall, I'm pretty impressed. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly and does t irritate my sensitive skin.

Ive suffered from sensitive skin for years and I decided to try out this moisturizer. I love this brand so much because it's lightweight but very cooling and moisturizing. Absolutely wpild recommend this to anyone who struggles with sensitive skin or doesnt want a very greasy moisturizer

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I definitely felt the cooling hydration of the lotion. It made my face feel so refreshed after using. I did feel it took a while for it to be absorbed into my skin and there was a bit leftover on my finger tips.

My skin has changed recently and I was lead to this brand by a helpful sales person.. I wear this in the am only and the richer one at night time for sensitive skin! It's been working for me!! I have dry sensitive skin and this stuff cal s it down.. Been using for awhile now! Love it!

avis.titre: So good for KP on my face
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is such an amazing face lotion! It's lightweight but yet deeply hydrating. I primarily use this for daytime and it leaves my skin glowy and works well under makeup. I have redness and KP on my face and I find that this lotion helps keep it calm and at bay with ingredients like colloidal oatmeal and urea. Holy grail type product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lightweight and soothing daily face lotion that delivers reliable hydration with colloidal oatmeal and nourishing oils. Absorbs quickly without greasiness, calming dry or sensitive skin and prepping smoothly under makeup. Great for everyday use, though some find it lighter than richer creams and wish for deeper moisture in very cold weather.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I did one pump on my hand and look at that thick lotion! I have really sensitive skin so whenever I find products that are on the thicker side, I love them!! I rubbed the product on my hand & it ended up burning my skin so bad, it made it irritated and red. I decided not to try it on my face since I've noticed when I try it on my hand & I get a irritating reaction, putting the product on my face makes it way worse and I start to feel like my face is itchy, inflamed, & really dry.

I have been using this for a little bit now and I really like it! It's very lightweight and hydrating for my skin especially during these dry winter months! It absorbs really well and leaves my skin soft and smooth. I definitely recommend it!
The Ultra Repair Face Lotion is make My skin look good. Make my skin smooth, hydration. I feel confident after I use it.

First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion Daily Hydration with Colloidal Oatmeal is a favorite of mine. Leaves face feeling smooth and never irritates. Daily use morning and night. This is now my go to cream. First Aid Beauty products are always a good value and contains the best mixture of ingredients for your skin.

avis.titre: Good but needs to be more hydrating
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have combination skin that can sometimes be sensitive and I also have acne prone skin meaning that I can get acne at unprecedented times. I always say something that can be very hydrating on my skin but at the same time something that will not congested or make it feel irritated. Once I had applied this to my skin after cleansing it and putting on other skin care products I noticed on my skin had looked nourished and less red. The formula is not thick at all but a decent kind of balance to it that you will get what you are looking for from this moisturizer. I easily just have to pump out at least two to three pumps of this and just spread it around on my face in an upward motion. I will have to say I wish this was a little more hydrating for my skin as it does give me a hydrated look when I first apply it but it looks like it goes away within a short time. This is not a bad cream at all I just think it could do more and I wish it did more for my skin rather than just taking away redness and taming it as hydration is really key since my skin is dry mostly during this time in the cold season.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This lotion works so good! My skin is so dry from the cold and wind and this is the first lotion I've tried that has helped the dryness. It doesn't smell either

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this product for about a week and is my favorite moisturizer ever. I'm so glad I got this product to try because I have found a new favorite it absorbs beautifully. There's no scent and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated.

This mousturizer feels great on my skin because its so lightweight. Its moisturizing, too! It's winter and my skin is very dry so I like somethinh heavier this time of year. It would be perfect during months when the weather isnt so dry.

I recently tried the repair lotion, and I've noticed my skin has become softer especially during the winter season. I use it along with my moisturizer morning and night it has helped tremendously to soften those dry areas that I struggle with. the texture of the lotion is thick, creamy, soft, and gel like. I would recommend if you struggle with dry winter skin.

I like the FAB Ultra Repair Face Lotion because it is lightweight and absorbs easily into the skin without feeling greasy. For more intense hydration, the Ultra Repair Cream is my go-to. You can't go wrong with this moisturizer! Gifted by FAB.

I received this item for free for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The best lotion they really has repaired my skin from dryness and they absorbs in my skin so nicely and makes it feel so soft and refreshed. It is so hydrating in the oatmeal smells so nice on my face.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] it's been a great option for my dry, sensitive skin. I love that it's fragrance-free, gentle, and layers well under makeup without pilling. While it's not a super rich cream, it's perfect for everyday use when I want soothing, reliable moisture. I will use it as my daytime moisturizer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm going to say a lot of really good things about this product. I love it. First of all, it's unscented which is always a HUGE plus for me. It's very absorbent and doesn't leave a sticky feel, which you can get either colloidal oatmeal. The dispenser is clean and easy to use. It really soothes my allergy-prone skin. I'll probably still use my regular routine, but during an eczema flare, this stuff will be great!

As I kept using it over the course of about 2 weeks i noticed that it was causing my skin to break out and also dry up. This is my to go moisturizer when my skin feels sensitive, irritated agf dry. It has lightweight soft texture that absorbs really well and deeply hydrates the skin. An absolute must for cold season.

Love this face lotion. It feels lightweight but still really nourishing, sinks in fast, and leaves my skin soft with that smooth, velvety finish. It also layers nicely under makeup and doesn't feel pore-clogging on me.

The FAB Ultra Repair Lotion is a new favorite in my skincare routine! It absorbs into the skin quickly and doesn't leave me feeling greasy. In fact it leaves behind a nice velvety smooth finish and it works great under makeup. My skin feels moisturized all day long.

I am a huge fan of First Aid Beauty products. This moisturizer did not disappoint. It immediately left my skin feeling hydrated and moisturized. Not greasy or sticky at all! It runs in very quickly. It's perfect for these winter months when my skin is super dry. I received this product free in exchange for my honest review.

First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion 1.7 fl. oz. is a morning and night hydrating lotion with Colloidal Oatmeal. It is a lightweight formula that absorbs fast, is great under make up, and does not leave a sticky residue. This product is unscented and is good for all skin types, including sensitive skin. First Aid Beauty Ultra Face Lotion 1.7 fl.oz. contains Colloidal Oatmeal, a powerhouse ingredient that is recommended for Soothing Dry/Itchy Skin, Reducing Redness and Inflammation, Strengthening Skin Barrier, Protecting Skin, Eczema, Psoriasis, Sunburn, Poison Ivy, Chicken Pox, and Razor Burn. After using this product for a few days, my skin feels extra soft, moisturized, and has a healthy looking glow. This lotion is very concentrated, the pump is easy to use, and a little goes a long way. It is made in the USA with local and imported ingredients. I would highly recommend this product. I will be purchasing First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion 1.7 fl.oz.
I absolutely love this moisturizer! It absorbs really quickly, and leaves my skin feeling hydrated but not greasy! I love the pump packaging so much easier to apply or take on the go!

Is collodial oatmeal the IT ingredient of the year? Feels like it! This moisturizer is so hydrating and leaves my skin feeling plump and soft. I find it to be more cost effective than other brands coming out with collodial oatmeal creams. Im a fan - definitely recommend!
This face lotion is so lightweight and hydrating. It sunk into my skin easily leaving me moisturized all day long.

This Face Lotion has been a lifesaver for my skin this winter. It's lightweight yet deeply moisturizing, absorbs quickly, and keeps my dry skin feeling soft, comfortable, and nourished all day. Perfect for cold-weather dryness!

I have really dry and flaky skin that looks dull and this moisturizer really helps. My skin soaks it right up after it just melts into my skin. My face looks so smooth, glowy, and it does not feel heavy at all when applied.

This is a really nice moisturizer. It's super nourishing but feels lightweight on my skin. I struggle with eczema and colloidal oatmeal is one of my favorite ingredients, so love that it's included in this. While I can use it as my nighttime moisturizer, I prefer something a little heavier at night (I'm 50 and my skin is getting drier by the minute). But it's lovely as a daytime moisturizer. And I am always happy to see the Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance!

This face lotion is lightweight and provides instant hydration to my face without feeling greasy at all. I have dry skin and it absorbed almost instantly into my skin so I'm sure this lotion is perfect for all skin types. It is unfragranced/unscented.

I like this ultra repair face lotion. It's lightweight and absorbs nicely. It's hydrating but not greasy, oily or heavy. I have super dry skin and it's does a good job for me. I like the pump dispenser, it gives me just the right amount of product, no waste.
I love this moisturizer. It's lightweight. Doesn't leave my skin greasy. Absorbs nicely into the skin. Sits well under makeup. Perfect packaging for travel. Amazing hydration!

This product contains very highly comedogenic ingredients like shea butter and glyceryl stearate. I would not recommend this to anyone with acne prone skin. After using it for about two weeks I noticed very small break outs around my eyes.

I have bought this moisturizer several times over the past couple years and have always liked thefeel and how how it made my skin feel , but the last one I got smells terrible like a perm solution and has a burning tingling sensation to my face. I will not be purchasing this again.

Loved this moisturizer and probably went through 6+ in the past several years. However, I repurchased one in April and it seriously irritated my face and smelled like a hair removal cream. Also looked completely different in color and in texture than previous purchases. Seems like I'm not the only one dealing with this. Very dissapointed :(

avis.titre: So Disappointed - Not the Same Product
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for two years now, but the bottle I just received is not the same. It's a gross, gray-beige color, runny, and it smells so strongly of ammonia that I don't even want to put it near my face. Since they're denying there's been any formula change, it must be a quality control issue, which is somehow worse. I'm bummed that I need to find a new go-to moisturizer - I really did love this stuff - and I feel like I can't trust their other products now, either.

This has been my go to for years, it's the only product that sits well under my makeup and doesn't break me out. I bought a new bottle a couple weeks ago and it seems as if the formula has changed. It's not as moisturizing and I'm breaking out.

I used to love this product! It was the ONLY thing I could use for my sensitive skin. I loved the formula and the light scent didn't give me a headache. I was out and waited for my new one to come in, but it's smells TERRIBLE and looks yellow almost like the oatmeal went bad. I am so disappointed because I really needed my favorite product and it was so expensive! Please bring the old formula back!!!

The product is fine when you apply it, but an hour later, my skin does not still feel moisturized. It is definitely not Ultra. This product is probably better suited to someone with oilier skin, which is not me.

avis.titre: Used to be great, now overpriced and bad formula
avis.texte: I used this product for YEARS but over last fall/winter it started pilling horribly and completely stopped providing any moisture, my skin was flaking constantly. Not to mention they have quite literally doubled the price since I started using it

Purchased this after extensive research for a new moisturizer for my face. I'm in my 40s, have combination skin, and also sensitive to many products. This goes on light and smooth, settles softly and gives off such a nice, dewy glow. Will def repurchase.

I'm so upset they changed the formula. Like others have mentioned, it's now a weird beige color instead of white, it has a thinner/runnier consistency, and it smells terrible. They totally changed what used to be my staple moisturizer. So disappointing that after years I have to find a new moisturizer.
My daily moisturizer! My absolute favorite ever. I use this or the same one in sunscreen version! I can not get enough of this stuff. Wish it came in a bigger bottle!

avis.titre: The color is beige not white.

This use to be my go to for years! I loved how moisturizing it was and yet still lighteight enough to use am/pm. Absorbed wuickly and left a subtle glow. Keep in mind it was also white in color Now unfortunately Ive come across two bottles at Ulta that have been tan in color, greasy upon coming out of the bottle almost leaving an oiling liquid around cream, its a lot thinner in consistency and leaves my face looking as if i have bacon grease on instead of moisturizer. Used this product since 2020 due to my sensitive skin. Last two times I bought this product had a very off putting toxic smell, almost like a Lysol or alcohol odor. Color used to be white now it's grey… it now burns my skin and is unbearable to use. Lost a loyal customer of 5+ years. It's false advertisement now. Come to find out the ingredients have been switched. This company will be hearing from my attorney.

avis.titre: Would not buy this again. Would not recommend.
avis.texte: First of all this smells like alcohol. Second it leaves my skin feeling very clogged and oily.

I have incredibly oily, acne prone skin that is also quite sensitive. I've heard such great things about this, and know so many people love it. Unfortunately, it's not for me. Any time I wore it, it made my skin tingle, so I think I must have some sort of allergy to something in it. It made many of my foundations sit weird, and didn't play well with a lot of my other skincare products. I had the same issue with their eye cream. I really wanted to love this one, because it did help with oil control!! The finish is pretty similar to the Clinique Moisture Surge and the Neutrogena HydroBoost (before it was reformulated), so I was hoping it could be one that would fit in with those. I got thorugh 1/4 of the container, really gave it a good go, and decided it wasn't for me. I typically will use moisturizers that I decide don't work for my face on my body, just to get all those great skin benefits. And I can say it felt amazing on my body!! I do also love that there aren't any dyes or fragrance in this, as those are common irritants for my skin.

Im so disappointed... I used to love this moisturizer. I mean this was THE moisturizer I would always run back to. But the last two times I bought it (from separate locations), it smells so off, the color is off and it leaves a tacky feeling. And all followed by irritation. I don't know what is happening or they just changed the formula but I'm so sad.
This came in a fab fit fun box and I'm so glad it did. It beats all the expensive moisturizers I used to use. No scent. Light, fresh, and deeply moisturizing. Love, love, love

I cannot live without this moisturizer. The moment I run out and use anything else for a period of time I am quickly reminded why it's my holy grail product. I have combination skin that tends to lean towards the dryer side during winter. I am also prone to redness, bumps, dry patches, and irritation. This is one of the only moisturizers I can use that doesn't upset my skin barrier. I am also an avid user of their facewash.

I bought this a few month's back. I haven't used it much because the smell is so off putting. It smells just like the chemicals used for perms I got in the 90s. I wish I could return it for another item.
This used to be my favorite moisturizer but the formula has changed. It is much thinner and does not absorb well into my skin anymore.

I used to buy this religiously and I restocked recently with THREE tubes only to find the formula has changed. It's no longer white and has an almost oatmeal color. It also seems to be adding some acne I've never experienced before with this moisturizer. I guess I'll power through my three bottles but then I'm going to need to find another moisturizer.

This used to be my holy grail and have bought over and over for years, but this new bottle the formula is different and smells strong like alcohol. I tried it for a few days and it's breaking me out. So bummed and on the search for a new one.
They changed the formula for this product. It now leaves a tacky residue on my skin. Such a disappointment. FAB lost a loyal customer
Alcohol is one of the first ingredients which is a giveaway but this is not a great product for moisturization or repairing skin barrier. Save your money

My skin is very sensitive and balks at a lot of stuff. I can't wear a too-heavy moisturizer, but I have really dry winters and my skin needs moisture. My face loves this. It is my go-to moisturizer, I will never stop buying it.

It's okay, it's a moisturizer. But gives my skin a bit of texture, and makes me break out. they usually recommend it to me when they "discontinue" skin rescue daily face cream, but it doesn't compare, it's not a good replacement for that one, in my experience/opinion.

I have very sensitive skin and have struggled for years to find a moisturizer that doesn't irritate my skin. This goes on very light as well. It has zero fragrance and is super gentle. I mix it with a little vitamin C serum to jazz it up a little in the winter. This has been my go-to for years. I have pretty oily/combo skin so the fact that it is light works well for my skin. Folks who need have dry skin might not find it sufficient.
Bought this product on sale and thought it would be good for my dry sensitive/acne prone skin… unfortunately this cream it tends to not make my skin feel hydrated and breaks me out :(

avis.titre: Didn't work on my dry skin
avis.texte: My face still felt thirsty on my dry skin, had to apply more then usual in order for it to feel moisture on my skin, will not be purchasing this product again.

This is an unscented moisturizer with the harsh chemicals removed, for us folks with sensitive skin. It works without causing any allergic reactions. I do wish it was a little more moisturizing, it seems to just soak up into my skin. Good product.
One of the best moisturizers I've ever bought! I have really dry skin and this stuff works. It's super lightweight too which is nice because it doesn't clog my pores. Would definitely buy again!!
